pages: Had a nightmare, love? I should know, I have taken care of you for years
Go on... Take a sip of that potion over there, hold it in your hand and press E.
Odeysseus...look, the smart move here would be to use the bow you salvaged. Hold TAB, hover a shaft, release to equip it.
Hold the right mouse button to draw the bow. The longer you hold, the farther your arrow flies.
Release, and let fly. Miss, and I shall never let you forget it.
